title: 第75章 人家的钱想咋花都跟你没关系
content_zh:
第75章 人家的钱想咋花都跟你没关系-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

老宅那边，是林美玲来报的喜讯。

李红霞听完，坐在炕上半天没动。

“三千五的房子……说买就买了？”

“嗯。”林美玲说，“镇南头，三间门面，后院三间瓦房，带个大院子。”

林国伟蹲在门口，脸色铁青。

林国栋在旁边嘀咕：“有这钱，给老宅翻修翻修多好。”

林海柱磕了磕烟袋，看了小儿子一眼。

“人家的钱，人家想咋花咋花，跟你没关系。”

林国栋讪讪地闭了嘴。

李红霞忽然站起来：“不行，我得去看看。”

林海柱拉住她：“人家又没请你，你去干啥？”

“我是他妈！我看看他买的房子还不行了？”

“你消停点吧。”林海柱难得硬气了一回，“老二现在跟以前不一样了。

你越闹，他越远，不信你试试。”

李红霞被噎住了。

想起上回被林国强从店里撅回来的场景，她咬了咬牙，又坐了回去。

但心里那股滋味儿，说不上来。

像是自己的东西，忽然长腿跑了。

抓不住，也够不着。

晚上，林国强和赵素梅躺在炕上。

林静和林薇睡在中间，呼吸均匀。

“国强。”

“嗯？”

“咱什么时候搬？”

“六月十六，交了房就搬。”

林国强说，“这几天我去那边看看，该修的修，该补的补，刷遍白墙，换个新招牌。”

“新招牌叫啥？”

林国强想了想。

“国强饭店。”

赵素梅笑了：“这名字好，简单，响亮。”

“以后不光卖肉夹馍和卤味。”

林国强看着房梁，“炒菜、炖菜、包桌、办酒席，咱都干。

我要让这镇上的人，请客吃饭头一个就想到咱家。”

赵素梅侧过身，看着他的侧脸。

月光从窗户照进来，落在他脸上。

这个男人的眼睛里，有光。

“国强，我以前总觉得，咱这辈子就这样了。

守着几亩地，拉扯大孩子，凑合过一辈子。”

她轻轻握住他的手。

“现在我才知道，日子还能这么过。”

林国强反握住她的手。

Over at the old house, Lin Meiling came to report the good news.

After Li Hongxia listened, she sat on the kang without moving for a long time.

"A house worth three thousand and five thousand yuan...you just bought it as soon as you said you wanted to buy it?"

"Yeah." Lin Meiling said, "At the south end of the town, there are three facades, three tile-roofed houses in the backyard, and a big yard."

Lin Guowei squatted at the door, his face ashen.

Lin Guodong muttered beside him: "With this money, it would be great to renovate the old house."

Lin Haizhu blew his pipe and glanced at his youngest son.

"You can spend other people's money however they want, and it has nothing to do with you."

Lin Guodong shut his mouth.

Li Hongxia suddenly stood up: "No, I have to go take a look."

Lin Haizhu grabbed her: "I haven't invited you, so what are you going to do?"

"I'm his mother! Can't I just take a look at the house he bought?"

"Please calm down." Lin Haizhu said for a rare moment, "Second brother is different now.

The more trouble you make, the farther away he will be. If you don’t believe me, try it."

Li Hongxia was choked.

Remembering the scene when Lin Guoqiang pushed her back from the store last time, she gritted her teeth and sat back down.

But I can't describe the feeling in my heart.

It seemed like something that belonged to me suddenly ran away with long legs.

Can't catch it, can't reach it.

At night, Lin Guoqiang and Zhao Sumei were lying on the kang.

Lin Jing and Lin Wei slept in the middle, breathing evenly.

"Guoqiang."

"Huh?"

"When will we move?"

"June 16th, we'll move in after handing over the house."

Lin Guoqiang said, "I will go there to take a look in the past few days. Repair what needs to be repaired, mend what needs to be repaired, whitewash the walls, and replace the sign with a new one."

"What's the new sign called?"

Lin Guoqiang thought for a while.

"Guoqiang Hotel."

Zhao Sumei smiled: "This name is good, simple, and loud."

"In the future, we will not only sell roujiamo and braised meat."

Lin Guoqiang looked at the rafters, "We can cook, stew, set tables, and host banquets.

I want people in this town to think of our house first when they treat guests to dinner."

Zhao Sumei turned sideways and looked at his profile.

The moonlight shone in through the window and fell on his face.

There was light in this man's eyes.

"Guoqiang, I always thought that this is how we will be for the rest of our lives.

Guarding a few acres of land, taking care of the older children, and making do for the rest of your life."

She took his hand gently.

"Now I know that life can still go on like this."

Lin Guoqiang held her hand instead.
